title: fix(ui): queryGroupHeaders hands on the server's hasMore, and a cut lane read draws no lane figure
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Fixes #36870

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在限制了默认分页大小的部署上,看板泳道底部的合计、平均、最小、最大值,在服务器分组答案被截断时不再显示错误数字(如「合计 0」或少算),而是不显示;答案完整时照常显示。
- 为什么做:补上上一张卡评审记录(7124305685)里点名的两个残余情形(折叠泳道的部分合计、单次查询看板的「合计 0」)。这一族还有后续:列表里看板的单页合计和分组表格、币种读取的截断,另有卡承接。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是本该显示的泳道统计不显示,不会显示错误数字;分组表格与币种读取不受影响,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- `@object-ui/types`: new exported type `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer` = `ListViewGroupHeaderRow[] & { hasMore?: boolean }`; `DataSource.queryGroupHeaders` now answers it. `hasMore: true` means the answer is partial (the door cut the groups). A source returning a plain array still satisfies the member, and a caller reading the answer as an array is unchanged.
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `queryGroupHeaders` sets `hasMore = true` on the returned rows array when `POST /data/:object/query` answers `hasMore: true` (the grouped branch in `protocol-data-crud.ts` slices to the default page size and answers it). A whole answer carries no `hasMore`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: new `readLaneStatistic(answer, reading)` answers `null` (no figure for ANY lane) for a partial answer, else `readLaneFigures`. `ObjectKanban` reads the lane read through it. Covers both residual cases of scope note 7124305685: the folded "Uncategorized" lane's partial figure, and "Sum 0" on a board of one query whose lane group was cut. The `laneFigureOf` comment that said the flag is not handed on is corrected.
- The grouped grid (`useServerGrouping`), the whole-set footer (`useWholeSetSummary`) and `usedCurrencyCodes` are untouched and read the same array.

Clause-② measurement: after `@object-ui/types` build, `dist/index.d.ts` carries 1 hit and `dist/data.d.ts` 3 hits of `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer`; `git grep -c ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer 9171bed0a -- ui/` answers 0 hits (exit 1). `dist/data.d.ts:956` now types the member's return as a Promise of `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer`. One new exported name plus an optional field on the return: widening. A tsc probe (`--strict`) shows a plain `Row[]` is assignable to the new answer type, so no implementer is narrowed. The claim carried `Clause-②: no`; this PR declares what was measured.

## Tests

<details><summary>Targeted pins (new)</summary>

- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/queryGroupHeaders-7189.test.ts`, new describe: a door capped at a default page size of 2 over 5 groups gives `rows.hasMore === true`, rows still an array of the first 2; CONTROL page size 100: `hasMore` undefined, all 5 rows.
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370.test.tsx`, new top-level describe `a cut lane read draws no lane figure (objectstack#36870)` (the shared harness file): a lane door that cuts to `pageSize` rows and sets `hasMore`.
  - paged board, page size 3 (open, won, empty group of 4 groups): the answer's `hasMore` is true and no `[data-kanban-lane-statistic]` is drawn anywhere, Uncategorized included;
  - board of one query (`limit: 10`), page size 1: no "Sum 0" on Won, no figure anywhere;
  - CONTROL page size 4 (whole): Open 2415, Won 10, Lost 0, Uncategorized 4.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The grouped grid (`useServerGrouping`) and `usedCurrencyCodes` do not read the new flag: if their grouped read is cut, a grid could list fewer groups than exist and the currency read could miss a code. Read from code only, not run, so no reach is measured here; carrier: #37278 (Blocked-by #36870), filed at the seat's direction. Both callers keep working exactly as before, as the card asks.
- `laneFigureOf`'s `holdsRecords` guard stays: over a whole answer it still catches a board count and an answer that disagree (a write between the two reads).

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`, `readLaneStatistic`: the one line that turns a partial answer into no figures.
2. `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, `queryGroupHeaders`: where `hasMore` is set on the rows array.
3. `ui/packages/types/src/data.ts`, `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer`: the published shape.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && npx vitest run --root . packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370.test.tsx -t 36870` should show 3 passed.
